title: A unified modeling framework and improved formulations for single-hoist cyclic scheduling
summary: The cyclic hoist scheduling problem originates in electroplating lines, where a single or multiple hoists transport parts between processing tanks subject to technological constraints. The objective is typically to determine a cyclic sequence of hoist movements that minimizes the cycle time while satisfying travel and processing constraints.
